title: Build Jarvis
description:
Here’s how to build your own Jarvis in 30 seconds.
First, get a computer that can stay on 24/7, like a Mac Mini.
Then install an agent harness like Hermes and connect it to an AI model like OpenAI, Claude, or even a free local model.
Next, give it access to your browser, email, Notion, analytics, and any other tools you use.
Then create a simple Markdown file explaining exactly what the agent does, when it runs, and how it should complete each task.
Add repeatable skills for things like answering emails, checking business stats, building proposals, or creating content.
And finally, connect a voice with ElevenLabs so you can actually talk to it.
That’s it.
The fancy dashboard is optional.
The real Jarvis is the system running underneath it.
Comment “Jarvis” and I’ll send you the full breakdown.
